## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Not specified in the result; BS-synthetic P&L scales linearly with qty. Standard 3-contract minimum implies ~$1.67 entry premium would risk ~$500 per trade at $1K account size (50% risk cap). Actual deployment requires $25K+ for full headline P&L realization per L11.
2. **Sample bias:** Full historical SPY 5m bars used; no explicit IS/OOS split provided in result. Walk-forward held-out window intended per task but OOS/IS ratio not disclosed in artifact. High risk of overfit due to no explicit OOS validation in reported metrics.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS -- artifact does not contain explicit OOS P&L or OOS/IS ratio. Quarterly P&L shows mixed performance (2025-Q1:-$1300.5, 2025-Q2:+$769.79, 2025-Q3:-$1134.66, 2025-Q4:-$1246.16, 2026-Q1:+$1548.89, 2026-Q2:-$101.59) but no walk-forward stability metric.
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS -- engine note explicitly states "BS-synthetic option pricing ... NOT real-fills evidence." Top-3 J day P&L values (-$23.95, -$21.56, $804.72) are BS-synthetic and require real-fill validation per L12/L23.
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: max drawdown $4,701.52 (from result)
   - Regime sensitivity: 2025-Q3 and 2025-Q4 deeply negative (-$1,134.66, -$1,246.16) coinciding with low-VIX recovery regimes per L04/L22
   - Blow-up scenario: Consecutive losing quarters (2025-Q1 through Q4 except Q2) show strategy struggles in trending/low-vol environments
   - Concentration: top5_pct=999.0 (artifact artifact due to negative wide_pnl) but inspection of quarterly P&L reveals 2026-Q1 alone ($1,548.89) exceeds total wide_pnl (-$1,464.23) in magnitude, indicating extreme concentration
6. **Concentration:** With wide_pnl negative ($-1,464.23), top5_pct=999.0 indicates the strategy loses money outside its top 5 days. 2026-Q1 P&L ($1,548.89) > |total P&L|, implying >100% concentration in a single quarter -- highly regime-dependent edge.
